name: Snowflake Growth
desc: Reiter's hexagonal snowflake cellular automaton — vapor diffuses across a hex lattice and freezes onto a growing seed, spontaneously blooming a unique six-fold dendritic ice crystal that glitters and slowly turns, then dissolves so a fresh seed can grow.

scale.doc: crystal size (higher = larger flake, fills more of the frame)

density.doc: growth rate + facet detail + glitter count

vapor.doc: Reiter beta (background vapor) — low=sparse fern, high=full plate

branch.doc: Reiter gamma (vapor addition) — branchiness / growth speed

seed.doc: deterministic flake — every seed a different crystal
